summary: The registrant, Silver Point Specialty Lending Fund, filed an 8-K to disclose an unregistered sale of 182,017 common shares at $27.47 per share for $5 million under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D/S, and a regular monthly dividend of $0.24 per share declared on April 28, 2026. There is no special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring. The filing covers routine capital raising and dividend declaration, not a transformative corporate action. No recommended advice or risk-arb angle applies.
